title: Is there anything suspicious on my cards?

messages.content: Is there anything suspicious on my cards?

In the last 30 days I screened 56 card purchases: 2 were blocked as suspected fraud and 5 were flagged for review.

Needs your attention:
- **Blocked a suspicious $1,249.00 purchase**. GadgetZone Intl (SG) on card •• 9631 was declined with risk score 0.86. If this wasn't you, freeze the card.
- **Blocked a suspicious $899.00 purchase**. LuxeTime Watches (SG) on card •• 9631 was declined with risk score 0.80. If this wasn't you, freeze the card.
- **Did you spend $412.00 at GadgetZone Intl?**. The purchase was approved but looked unusual (risk 0.71): first purchase in this country; unusual time of day; large first purchase at a new merchant.
- **Did you spend $386.40 at Velvet Lounge?**. The purchase was approved but looked unusual (risk 0.60): larger than any earlier purchase; unusual time of day; large first purchase at a new merchant.

If you don't recognise these, freeze the card and report them as fraud from the Security page.
